messages:
kate: planning a small toggle to route ~20% traffic to /v2 for 30m starting in the 11:00 UTC change window. need 👀 on rollback criteria and any client pinlist updates.

mike: +1 but heads up — mobile SDKs still sending older header case variants. can we do header-case normalization at the gateway first?

ops_jordan: watching infra metrics. if p50 latency > 250ms or 5xx spike > 0.5% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets -> rollback. also want deploybot hook for auto-failback.

samir: suggest canary in EU only for first 10m, then expand. mobile SDK cohort -> add to pinlist until next SDK patch.

deploybot: deploy scheduled by kate at 2025-03-12T11:00:00Z. action: route-toggle v2 -> 20% (duration 30m). notify @eng-ops on threshold breach.

anya: quick checklist: 1) release notes updated with client guidance, 2) telemetry tags for v2 enabled, 3) canary probe set (`/health?probe=v2`)

mike: + release notes pulled into docs repo: https://go/docs/api-v2-rollout (preview). added note about x-client-version header handling.

kate: plan for fast-failback: deploybot CLI call below if thresholds hit
```
deploybot rollback --route /api --from v2 --to v1 --reason "auto-threshold"
```

ops_jordan: i'll wire alert to oncall: if 5xx > 0.5% for 2m OR p95 latency > 800ms, fire the CLI and pause further expansion.

samir: also capture sample failed payloads to s3://redwood-rollbacks/v2-samples for root-cause. retain for 7d.

mike: question — are we normalizing header case on the gateway or adding a fallback in v2? which is faster to ship?

kate: gateway normalization is turned on for this toggle (temporary shim). had to patch edge proxy — patch rolled to staging and smoke passed.

deploybot: toggle started at 2025-03-12T11:00:00Z -> routing 20% to v2. monitor id: rb-6123456789.

ops_jordan: first 5m: p50 120ms, p95 210ms, 5xx 0.02% — looks healthy.

mike: mobile cohort (tagged) showing some truncated responses for `stream=true` cases. low volume but nonzero. investigating.

anya: flagging docs: add a known-issue note about stream=false recommendation until mobile patch.

samir: recommend reduce to 5% and run extended 15m canary while mobile fix propagates.

kate: agreed. reducing now. deploybot: action?

deploybot: update route -> 5% at 2025-03-12T11:12:30Z (by kate).

ops_jordan: new metrics after shrink: p95 220ms, 5xx 0.03%. mobile truncated-case rate improved but still present for 0.01% of requests.

mike: rolling mobile SDK patch out to alpha users, should be in next 30m. once that's in, we can ramp.

kate: decision: keep at 5% for remainder of window, no full rollout until mobile cohort clears. will update release notes and pinlist (add mobile alpha as allowed ramp). if we see 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 800ms -> auto-rollback.

anya: logging: added tag `rollout_id: rb-6123456789` to traces and created eval set for sampling.

deploybot: toggle paused (no expansion) — will execute rollback if thresholds breached. final status at 2025-03-12T11:13:28Z: partial (5%) route to v2 active.

mike: thanks all. i'll follow up in 30m with mobile patch status and ramp recommendation. :thumbsup:

kate: thanks team — leaving this thread open for updates. if we need to rollback, use the CLI above and ping #eng-oncall.
